paragraphs.text: Sales of used clothes have grown faster than sales of new ones for five years. Apps that let people photograph a garment and list it in a minute did much of the work.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Shops have noticed. Two large chains now buy back their own garments, clean them and sell them again on a separate rail, usually at half the original price.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: The environmental gain is smaller than it looks. A garment worn twice as long saves far more than one that is resold and then hardly worn, and delivery vans add their own cost.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Charity shops complain that the best items no longer reach them. Their income has fallen, though the number of bags left at their doors has not.
paragraphs.label: D

items.prompt: a doubt about how much the practice helps
an effect on organisations that rely on donations
a reason why the growth happened
a company selling its own products a second time

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Which paragraph contains the following information? Write the correct letter, A–D. NB You may use any letter more than once.
